title: Account Manager (AgriBusiness/AgTech) – Midwest, Remote
description:
About Us

Founded in 2013 and headquartered in the Bay Area, Ceres AI connects field data to financial and operational decision making. Our team of agronomists, analysts, and scientists combines aerial and satellite imagery with machine learning to help agribusinesses, processors, and agricultural investors improve crop performance, manage risk, and use water, fertilizer, and chemicals more efficiently.

The Role

As Account Manager for the Midwest, you'll be the link between our platform and our customers' success.

You will own a book of mid-market and enterprise accounts, primarily in row crops. Your mandate is clear: keep customers, grow them, and win new ones.

Your First 30 Days

• Learn your portfolio: crop mix, acreage, priorities, platform usage, renewal timelines, and account health.

• Meet key stakeholders across each account, from agronomy and farm management teams to operations leaders and ownership groups.

• Partner with the Global Director - Row Crops and the broader commercial team on account transitions and growth plans.

• Map your territory's prospect landscape.

What You'll Do

Retain and grow your book of business

• Own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts, primarily in row crops, driving renewals and resolving escalations quickly.

• Deepen existing relationships through regular check-ins, in-season support, customer site visits, and industry trade shows and grower events.

• Lead regular business reviews focused on ROI, renewals, and next opportunities.

• Expand accounts through upsells, additional acreage, and new products and features.

Develop new business

• Source and close new business with large direct agribusinesses, processors, and ag capital groups through referrals, industry networks, and outreach.

• Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in Salesforce.

Drive adoption and measurable value

• Be the primary point of contact for customers using the Ceres AI platform.

• Help customers build Ceres imagery and analytics into their workflows and turn insights into outcomes: input and water efficiency, crop performance, and portfolio risk.

Partner across Ceres

• Work with sales leadership on renewals, expansion strategy, and enterprise pursuits.

• Coordinate with flight operations and the science team to deliver on schedule and to standard.

• Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.

Requirements

Must Have

• Degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Crop Science, or a related field, plus 5+ years in agribusiness, ag technology, crop advisory, or ag consulting.

• Proven track record growing mid-market or enterprise accounts through renewals and upsells, and closing new business.

• Strong working knowledge of large-scale row crop operations.

• Familiarity with precision ag or remote sensing, and the ability to translate data into operational and financial value.

• Clear, confident communication with both field teams and executives.

• Proficiency with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

• Residence in the Midwest and willingness to travel up to 40%.

Nice to Have

• Established relationships with large direct agribusinesses, processors, and/or agricultural capital investment groups.

• Hands-on experience with aerial or satellite imagery, NDVI, thermal imagery, or precision ag platforms.

• Background in ag SaaS, subscription services, or enterprise account management.

• Exposure to permanent or specialty crops.

How Success Is Measured

Within your first 90 days you will have:

• Taken full ownership of your portfolio and built trusted relationships at each account.

• Built an active new business pipeline in your territory.

• Delivered a retention and growth plan covering renewal risks and expansion priorities.

Ongoing, success is measured by gross and net revenue retention, expansion revenue, and new business closed.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insura

title: Facilities Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to 10s to 100s of GWs.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Sites come online in pieces, and you keep the live ones running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. No prior operations org has run at this speed and scale, so the standards you set become the standard.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own facility operations for the Lubbock site: MEP plant health, the maintenance program, and site services.

- Build the preventive maintenance program from OEM requirements and site history, then hold the schedule.

- Manage facility vendors and service contracts from scope to invoice.

- Partner with construction and commissioning so new capacity hands over to operations clean.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You've owned facility operations for a critical or industrial site.

- You've built or rebuilt a preventive maintenance program and can show the reliability improvement it produced.

- You manage vendor contracts with commercial discipline.

- You've taken buildings over from construction and know what a bad handover costs.

- Bonus: Data center experience. CMMS implementation. NFPA 70E. Water treatment programs.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. title: Mental Health Therapist - Indiana
description:
About NOCD
NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
About the Role
As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.
NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LMHC, LMFT, LCSW or Licensed Psychologists) in Indiana to join our team.
As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.
You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.
What You'll Do

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

• Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

title: Senior Director, Product, Security and Privacy
description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision: 

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.  

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

We are seeking a Product Counsel to partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and Go-To-Market teams to ensure our products are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with applicable laws and aligned with our risk tolerance.

This role is embedded in the product lifecycle, from roadmap planning and feature design through launch, customer adoption, and ongoing iteration, and is critical to enabling fast, responsible innovation in a global, enterprise software environment.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Engineering Support

• Act as the primary legal partner for product and engineering teams across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid offerings.

• Advise on legal issues throughout the product development lifecycle, including feature design, data flows, APIs, integrations, and platform architecture.

• Review and help shape product requirements, specifications, and launch plans to proactively manage legal risk.

Open Source & Licensing

• Advise on open-source software (OSS) usage, contributions, and licensing models (e.g., GPL, AGPL, Apache, MIT, dual licensing).

• Support compliance with open-source obligations and guide product teams on inbound and outbound licensing strategies.

• Partner with engineering and security on OSS governance and tooling.

Privacy, Security & Data

• Provide guidance on privacy and data protection matters (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, global data transfer frameworks).

• Advise on product-embedded privacy features, security controls, and data-handling practices.

• Partner with Security, Trust, and Compliance teams on incident response, customer security inquiries, and audits.

Commercial & GTM Enablement

• Support product-led go-to-market initiatives.

• Help develop scalable legal frameworks that enable enterprise sales while supporting self-serve and cloud motions.

Regulatory & Risk Management

• Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting enterprise software, AI, data, and cloud services, and translate them into practical guidance for product teams.

• Identify and assess legal risks associated with new technologies, features, and business models, and propose mitigation strategies.

• Contribute to internal policies, guidelines, and playbooks related to product development and delivery.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Educate and empower non-legal stakeholders through training and clear, pragmatic guidance.

• Help scale legal processes to support a fast-growing, global organization.

Qualifications

Required

• JD or equivalent law degree; licensed and in good standing in at least one jurisdiction.

• 10+ years of relevant legal experience,

title: Principal Clinical Content- Physician - UpToDate, Physician Editor, Adult Rheuma
description:
LOCATION:  U.S. locations - remote/hybrid. Candidates within commuting distance of a Wolters Kluwer office will be considered for hybrid employment. Candidates not within commuting distances will be considered for remote employment.
OVERVIEW
The  Physician Editor (Adult Rheumatology)  position requires an 80 to 90% FTE commitment for editorial work, a broad understanding of clinical issues, and an interest in analyzing the literature. For the right person, this is a unique opportunity to impact the practice of medicine throughout the United States and around the world. Physician Editors ensure that topics address the important clinical questions that arise when diagnosing or managing a specific disorder, present information clearly and succinctly, and provide evidence-based and actionable recommendations for care. Extensive editorial training is provided to help the editor learn critical skills for evaluating the literature and creating content in the UpToDate style. Training is overseen by at least two senior Physician Editors. All new topics are read and reviewed by the training editors until the new Physician Editor achieves a satisfactory level of independence.
You will be trained remotely and can work from anywhere in the United States; candidates within commuting distance of a Wolters Kluwer office will be considered for hybrid employment. Candidates not within commuting distances will be considered for remote employment. However, work hours should significantly overlap with standard work hours in the Eastern time zone to allow for regular interaction with other Physician Editors. Candidates with strong academic backgrounds are of particular interest. Editing requires 80 to 90% FTE. In the remaining 10 to 20% time, most Physician Editors remain involved in patient care activities, using their clinical experience to help ensure the content of the program is maximally useful at the point of care. Thus, the position provides the opportunity to remain clinically active, while spending the majority of your time crafting clear content, reviewing the literature, and discussing the impact of new research on clinical practice with our expert contributors.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Our physician editors review and edit the new contributions from our external expert authors to make sure they address the questions that a practicing clinician might have. Topics must contain specific and actionable recommendations and describe the supporting evidence. Updating is an equally important component of the work and is usually initiated by the Physician Editor, who is responsible for monitoring the literature for new developments and identifying topics that need updating. Physician Editors also systematically review existing topics for clarity, completeness, and clinical relevance. This work is not done in isolation. UpToDate editors work closely with outside authors, section editors, editors-in-chief, and peer reviewers to ensure the material is accurate and free of bias. In addition, in-house editorial and graphics assistants work with the Physician Editors to produce and maintain each topic.
QUALIFICATIONS
Required Education:

• Medical Degree

• Board Certification/Eligibility in Adult Rheumatology
Preferred Experience, Knowledge, and Abilities:

• Clinical experience in an academic setting after residency

• Impeccable communication skills: verbal, writing, and listening

• Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues at different skill levels

• Self-motivated, with excellent organizational and time management skills

• Ability to give and receive feedback effectively

• Interest in critical analysis of the medical literature (skills can be learned on the job)

• Ability to spend 80 to 90% of the work week on editorial work

• Interest in and ability to maintain clinical work (10 to 20%)
TRAVEL:  Minimal - less than 5%

title: Water Treatment Plant Maintenance Technician
description:
Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.

Woodard & Curran draws on the experience of hundreds of certified operators across the country, backed by the knowledge and skills of hundreds more engineers, scientists, and regulatory experts, to quickly tackle the most challenging operational issues and keep treatment plants running efficiently and in full compliance.  Woodard & Curran also aids employees in earning, upgrading, and keeping their certifications within the industry.
 
What will you be doing at Woodard & Curran?
 
In this role, you will participate in the daily maintenance and operations of the Water Treatment Plant facility (wells, pump, motors, etc.).as directed by the Project Manager.
 
Come be a part of a team that operates a water treatment plant that was built in 1941 by the US Army in Defiance, Missouri. This plant has been in operation for over 84 years and is still performing as it was designed.  We are designed to treat 22 million gallons a day, however currently we are averaging about 10 million a day.  There is going to be a lot of new equipment to learn the preventive maintenance on since a new capital project is starting now to add a new clarifier and replace the current three, we currently have.  Our influent source is ground water from an alluvial aquifer and nine alluvial wells that serve the water plant.  Our treatment consists of lime softening, disinfecting with sodium hypochlorite and secondary disinfection with aqua ammonia and addition of fluoride for dental health.  We have been 100% four log compliance for years to provide high quality drinking water for our client and their customers. Each day does require the maintenance technician to monitor the daily process and make sure that all the equipment is performing to the best of its ability to ensure the treatment process is of the highest quality.  If you are interested in conservation and working on multiple types of motors, pumps, transmitters, analyzers and general preventive maintenance of equipment interests you, then this is the place for you. Woodard & Curran is dedicated to our employees’ growth and development and wants to help you on your career path. 
 
The Defiance, MO water treatment plant staff is responsible for the operation and maintenance of the water treatment plant, the wells and the buildings and grounds.  This full-time position is responsible for the general maintenance of equipment at the water treatment plant and its related facilities.  The technicians’ primary focus will be working with the lead and performing preventative and corrective maintenance.  The secondary focus is assisting in operations of the plant when needed (i.e. filling in when for coworker vacation time or other reasons). There is routine weekly preventive maintenance assigned to this position.
 
 
Schedule:
 
The schedule for this position is Monday - Friday 7:00 am - 3:30 pm.  Currently there is not an on-call rotation. You will be required to respond to emergencies or unpredictable situations. In addition, this position will float as an operator when needed.

title: Cloud Cybersecurity Manager
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Cloud Cybersecurity Manager (CCM) to provide comprehensive leadership, cybersecurity governance, and mission-aligned security oversight across cloud-hosted applications and enterprise platforms supporting a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role provides multidisciplinary cybersecurity expertise, oversees cloud security operations, guides the implementation of cybersecurity strategy, and ensures compliance with federal, DoD, and cloud security frameworks.
The Cloud Cybersecurity Manager leads teams responsible for monitoring, securing, and optimizing the cyber posture of cloud-based systems while ensuring alignment with Zero Trust principles, continuous monitoring requirements, and risk management practices. This position supports high-visibility mission stakeholders and ensures that cybersecurity controls, engineering practices, and operational processes maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of mission data and services.
This position is fully remote.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Cloud Cybersecurity Manager will:

• Provide cybersecurity leadership, direction, and oversight for cloud-based enterprise systems and applications.

• Manage multidisciplinary cybersecurity teams supporting monitoring, incident response, vulnerability remediation, compliance, and audit readiness.

• Develop and implement cloud cybersecurity strategies, policies, standards, and best practices.

• Oversee security architecture decisions, including Zero Trust alignment, cloud security controls, and secure configuration baselines.

• Lead risk assessments, threat modeling, and continuous monitoring activities across cloud environments.

• Coordinate with cloud engineers, DevSecOps teams, and platform operations staff to ensure secure deployments and change controls.

• Manage vulnerability assessments, penetration findings, patching plans, and risk mitigation activities.

• Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity frameworks, NIST guidance, RMF processes, and cloud security directives.

• Provide leadership during cyber incidents including triage, containment, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and reporting.

• Maintain documentation of cybersecurity controls, system security artifacts, audit responses, and governance materials.

• Present cybersecurity metrics, risk summaries, compliance updates, and recommendations to senior government stakeholders.

• Oversee access control models, identity integration, privileged access management, and continuous authentication practices.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives for cloud cyber operations, monitoring capabilities, and automation of security processes.
Qualifications
Clearance Requirement
Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.
Education (Required)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Experience (Required)

• Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity or cloud security engineering.

• Minimum 8 years managing cybersecurity projects of similar size, scope, and complexity.

• Experience managing cybersecurity operations, risk management, monitoring programs, or security architecture for federal or DoD systems.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary cybersecurity teams including analysts, engineers, and incident responders.

• Experience with cloud security governance, secure configuration management, and continuous monitoring.
Technical Knowledge (Required)

• Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks including NIST 800-53, RMF, and DoD cloud security standards.

• Knowledge of cloud security controls across AWS, Azure, or similar cloud environments.

• Experience with threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management.

• Knowledge of identity and access management, privileged access controls, and authentication patterns.

title: Android Engineer, Plugin Developer Platform
description:
About the Team

The Plugin Developer Platform team builds the APIs, SDKs, and tools that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, connectors, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and interactive apps.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work covers plugin creation and publishing, the systems that run plugins across our products, and open standards that developers can build on.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Android engineer to bring plugins, connectors, and interactive apps to life on mobile. You’ll build the Android experiences and platform foundations that help developers extend ChatGPT and help users discover and use those capabilities from their devices.

You’ll work across native Android interfaces, developer-facing APIs, and the systems that support extensibility on mobile. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, and platform engineers, owning features from early exploration through implementation, launch, and iteration.

You’ll also engage directly with developers and partners to understand how their workflows translate to Android. Their experience will inform the interfaces and abstractions you build, the problems you prioritize, and the tradeoffs you make.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Build Android experiences for plugins, connectors, and interactive apps within ChatGPT.

- Develop reusable Android components and interfaces that support a growing ecosystem of developer-built experiences.

- Partner with platform engineers to connect native mobile experiences with APIs, SDKs, and backend systems.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help us build the foundation for this new ecosystem. Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

We're seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build the agentic layer of our Physical AI platform. You'll design, build and ship the agents behind our engineering copilot: systems that take a real engineering problem from an automotive, industrial or robotics team, explore the data, build and evaluate models, and return results an engineer can trust and act on.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research role. • Instrument agents with tracing and observability and use that data to improve them.

• Take agents from prototype to production: testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and on-call ownership.

ML & Domain Work

• Translate the vocabulary and workflows of physical engineering domains into agent behaviour, working with Forward Deployed Engineers and customers.

• Cover ML engineering work when needed, and help ML Engineers adopt agentic tooling in their own workflows.

Collaboration

• Work with Research to turn promising agentic approaches into production systems.

• Partner with platform engineers on the agent runtime, workflow orchestration and auth as the platform moves to a distributed, agentic-ready architecture.

• Work with Frontend and Product to expose agent capabilities in the product in a way non-ML engineers trust.

• Mentor engineers, and interview and onboard new team members.

O Backoffice atua em demandas internas de maior complexidade e impacto para a operação, apoiando diferentes áreas e garantindo a execução dos fluxos de Collections (cobrança) e Evictions (despejo). performance-based increase after 6 months
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.
This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead , identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.
We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.
Key Responsibilities
Insurance Verification
Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.
Denied Claims Management
Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.
EOB Processing
Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.
Patient Balance Resolution
Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.
Claims Processing
Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.
Payment Coordination
Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.
SOAP Note Monitoring
Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.
Appointment Tracking
Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.
Reports and Operational Tracking
Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.
Team Coordination
Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.
Operational Support
Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.
Mandatory Requirements

• Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

• Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

• Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

title: Public Engagement Manager
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

As the policy landscape evolves, so does the need for Instacart to deepen its grassroots presence across key regions of the country. This role is focused on expanding our public engagement footprint in the Midwest, mid-Atlantic, and the South - connecting with shoppers, customers, and community members who care about issues like protecting the independence and flexibility of app-based workers, preserving access to online savings for customers, and improving access to food security programs. Imagine yourself building a network of Instacart advocates in new markets, leveraging digital tools to drive engagement and shape public opinion, surfacing proactive organizing opportunities before they become reactive scrambles, and showing up with speed and precision when policy windows open. This is a role for someone equally comfortable building relationships in person as they are running a sophisticated digital engagement program - and who thrives at the intersection of community organizing and public policy.

 

What you'll cook up in your first year

• A structured cohort of Instacart shopper and customer advocates is established across priority Midwest, mid-Atlantic and Southern markets, with a consistent cadence of in-person and virtual touchpoints that build community, deepen relationships, and keep advocates informed and ready to act.

• Digital organizing levers - email, SMS, organic social, and other channels - are fully utilized to drive grassroots engagement, with clear benchmarks in place to measure performance and campaign learnings applied continuously to improve outcomes.

• Political and policy developments are monitored proactively, with strategic grassroots opportunities identified and surfaced to leadership before moments become reactive - not just executing on direction, but helping set it.

• Close collaboration with the Federal Affairs team results in targeted grassroots engagement with federal stakeholders, with shopper, customer, and community voices woven into federal advocacy efforts.

• Rapid response capacity is demonstrated through time-sensitive policy campaigns, with Instacart advocates mobilized quickly and effectively across multiple geographies.

 

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• 5+ years of experience in grassroots organizing, community engagement, digital strategy, political campaigns, or public affairs

• Demonstrated ability to recruit, train, develop, and deploy advocate networks at scale - aligning stakeholders' interests with organizational priorities and designing opportunities that deepen long-term engagement

• Subject matter expert on grassroots mobilization strategies, with the ability to provide briefings and recommendations to leadership

• Strong digital organizing skills - comfortable with CRM systems, advocacy platforms

title: Head of Partner Sales (h/f/d)
description:

Nous recherchons un(e) Head of Partner Sales (h/f/d) basé(e) à Paris pour rejoindre notre mission chez EGYM Wellpass. À la croisée du management stratégique, de la performance commerciale et de la collaboration inter-équipes, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre présence en France et en Belgique.

En tant que responsable de la stratégie Partner Sales, vous ferez le lien entre nos différentes équipes internes (RevOps, Account Management, Operations, Corporate Sales) pour transformer la stratégie commerciale en croissance sur l'ensemble du territoire national, tout en animant et développant une équipe performante.

YOUR DAILY WORKOUT

- Manager et développer l'équipe : Vous encadrez, accompagnez et faites grandir une équipe de Partner sales avec une posture managériale affirmée pour garantir l'atteinte des objectifs.

- Piloter les rituels d'équipe : Vous animez l'ensemble des rituels managériaux et opérationnels au quotidien (1:1 hebdomadaires avec l'équipe et avec le Senior Director Partner Management, Weekly Captain, Bi-weekly équipe et Partner Sales).

- Co-construire la roadmap : Vous définissez la stratégie commerciale B2B et coordonnez les objectifs avec l'équipe RevOps pour aligner l'exécution sur les ambitions globales de l'entreprise.

- Maximiser les synergies avec l'Account Management : Vous pilotez la relation et les processus communs avec l’équipe Account Management (onboarding des partenaires, réduction du churn, fluidité du cycle Partner) et veillez à une collaboration inter-équipes.

- Structurer les clusters et l'expansion : Vous identifiez les comptes stratégiques (grands comptes) et développez les clusters de demain (densification des secteurs existants et ouverture de nouvelles verticales) pour étendre notre empreinte partout en France et en Belgique.

- Optimiser le positionnement et l'offre marché : Vous analysez la concurrence, adaptez la stratégie tarifaire et veillez à faire rayonner la marque EGYM Wellpass comme un acteur de référence sur le marché français et belge.

YOUR FITNESS LEVEL

- Expérience en management : Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans le management et le coaching d'une équipe commerciale (idéalement 8 personnes ou plus), en faisant preuve d'une posture managériale affirmée et d'un bon équilibre entre vision stratégique et exécution terrain.

- Stratégie commerciale & de clusters : Vous possédez une solide expérience dans la construction et l'exécution de roadmaps commerciales B2B, avec une expertise dans la cartographie des comptes stratégiques, la densité de clusters et la couverture nationale.

- Collaboration transversale : Vous excellez dans la coordination inter-équipes (RevOps, Account Management, Operations, Sales Corporate) et la création de synergies opérationnelles fluides.

- Culture du chiffre & des objectifs : Vous portez une attention forte aux métriques de vente, aux taux de conversion et au pilotage de la performance globale.

- Compétences linguistiques : Vous maîtrisez l'anglais professionnel courant (langue de travail au quotidien) ainsi que le français.

YOUR TRAINING GOAL FOR YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS

- Maîtrise du marché et du périmètre : Vous avez réussi votre onboarding, acquis une compréhension fine du terrain, analysé notre positionnement concurrentiel et mis en œuvre les objectifs stratégiques (verticales, clusters, nouvelle grille tarifaire) pour renforcer le positionnement d'EGYM Wellpass en France.

- Garantie de la performance d'équipe : Vous vous êtes imposé(e) comme le moteur opérationnel et le/la garant(e) de la surperformance et de l'atteinte des objectifs de votre équipe de 8 personnes.

- Intégration inter-équipes : Vous avez bâti de fortes synergies de travail avec les autres départements pour fluidifier la transmission des leads et la rétention des partenaires.
